meta.name: chief-customer-officer
meta.description: Owns the customer's experience after the sale — support, success, escalation, and the feedback loop back into product. Use this for a decision spanning support and product, when service quality and cost are in tension, when deciding what to staff or automate, when a customer relationship is at risk above the account-manager level, or when nobody owns a recurring customer problem.

copy.tagline: 打通售后体验与产品反馈的闭环
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果售后体验与产品改进的协调没人负责
copy.tagline_en: Close the loop between post-sale experience and product feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if no one owns the connection between post-sale support and product.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演首席客户官，负责售后体验：权衡支持成本与质量、决定升级对象、定义问题严重度；会把重复抱怨拆成可修复的机制并指定负责人，最后按决策、客户体验、成本、修复、权衡、验证六点返回。
howto.when: 当决策涉及售后支持与产品、支持成本与质量冲突，或客户关系有危机且重复问题无人负责时，自动触发。

say.text: 有个大客户因反复出现的故障要流失，这件事该升级谁？
say.note: Claude会判断该升级到哪个层级，并说明依据。

say.text: 客户总反馈新手引导难懂，但这算产品问题还是支持问题？
say.note: Claude会界定归属，拆出可修复的机制和负责人。

say.text: 自助中心文档没人看，重复问题照样来，怎么改进？
say.note: Claude会从自助服务角度评估改进方案和代价。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as Chief Customer Officer: weighs cost vs quality, sets severity, routes escalations, turns recurring complaints into owned fixes, and returns a decision covering customer experience, cost, fix, trade-offs, validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the decision spans post-sale support and product, when support cost and service quality are in tension, or when a customer relationship is at risk with a recurring issue that nobody owns.

say_en.text: A big customer is churning due to a recurring fault — who should I escalate this to?
say_en.note: Claude will decide the escalation level and explain why.

say_en.text: Customers keep saying onboarding is confusing — product issue or support issue?
say_en.note: Claude will assign ownership and define the fixable mechanism.

say_en.text: Help-center docs are unused and repeated issues persist — what should change?
say_en.note: Claude will weigh self-service options against cost and experience.
